name: harness-zero
version: the zero.ts sha256 below; Harness Zero has no upstream release

integrity.checked: tests/harness-zero-image.test.ts compares both with the checkout; at image build the Dockerfile checks bun --version; adapter.sh compares bun --version with bun_version before anything else and exits 2 on a difference; preflight compares zero.ts, adapter.sh, pin.json, the Dockerfile and every file under config/ in the image with the checkout (HE-ADAPTER-005); the Dockerfile has no build arguments, so the base image is always the pinned digest

install: none: zero.ts imports only Bun and node: built-ins, so there is no package, lockfile or install step; the Dockerfile copies zero.ts, adapter.sh, pin.json, the Dockerfile and config/ into /opt/harness
turn_command: adapter.sh execs bun /opt/harness/zero.ts run|serve; zero.ts runs every turn in-process (no child process per turn)

model.provider: the last segment of HE_MODEL_BASE_URL: anthropic, openai or particle

wires.anthropic: POST <base>/v1/messages, x-api-key, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, not streamed; thinking blocks with signatures are kept and sent back
wires.openai-responses: POST <base>/v1/responses, Authorization Bearer, not streamed, store false, include reasoning.encrypted_content; reasoning items and call ids are kept and sent back
wires.chat-completions: POST <base>/v1/chat/completions, Authorization Bearer, not streamed; tool call ids and reasoning_content are kept and sent back

model.wire_by_provider: config/features.json knobs.wire: anthropic -> anthropic, openai -> openai-responses, particle -> chat-completions; a set may choose chat-completions for openai
model.api_key_env: HE_MODEL_API_KEY, sent as x-api-key (anthropic) or the bearer (openai, particle)
model.model_setting: HE_MODEL_NAME on every request; zero.ts has no other model id and no fallback
model.max_tokens: knob max_tokens, 16000 by default, on every request (max_tokens, max_output_tokens or max_completion_tokens); the proxy's --max-output-tokens must be at least that
model.thinking: only under effort-high: anthropic thinking {type: adaptive} with output_config.effort high, openai reasoning.effort high, chat-completions reasoning_effort high
model.retries: knob retry_max (6): 429, 500, 502, 503, 529 and overloaded_error, and a refused connection, with exponential backoff from 500 ms honoring retry-after and retry-after-ms, never past the turn budget; none on 400, 401, 402, 403 or 422

mcp_config_path: none: zero.ts is its own MCP client (Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18, JSON or SSE answers, Mcp-Session-Id) to HE_WORLD_MCP_URL and, when set, HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL, with the bearer from the environment; nothing is written to disk. Tools register as mcp__world__<tool> and mcp__gbrain__<tool>
network: internal required: a harness-zero cell without network internal is refused at plan (HE-NET-001), like codex
multi_user_mode: one process per trial, one session per conversation key; nothing shared between keys except scoped-notes within one scope
configs: HE_HARNESS_CONFIG names a set: zero-min, zero-full (the default when empty), zero-full-no-<slug> for each feature, or a set in config/candidates.json; any other value exits 2 before ready (HE-ZERO-001) and plan, dry-run and preflight refuse it

serve.session_key: dm:<member> | channel:<id>; :t<thread_ts> appended when TurnRequest.thread_ts is set
serve.session_store: /harness-state/zero/sessions/<sha256(key)>.json (the wire-native history, the system prompt fixed at the session's start); notes under /harness-state/zero/notes/<sha256(scope)>.json
serve.reply_source: the last assistant text of the turn; null when the turn ended with none (the step cap before any text, or an empty answer)
serve.exit_mapping: see the zero.ts header and docs/errors.md HE-ZERO rows: 0 completed (also at the step cap); 124 past the turn budget (the in-flight request is aborted); 3 for 401, 402, 403 and retryable statuses after retries (HE-ZERO-007); 2 for a provider 400 or 422 (HE-ZERO-004), an MCP server that cannot be (re)initialized (HE-ZERO-005), a crash (HE-ZERO-006), a turn an earlier serve process started and never answered (HE-ZERO-006, not run again), a malformed request file (HE-ZERO-009, serving goes on) and SIGTERM during a turn
serve.telemetry: one ZERO_TURN JSON line per turn and one ZERO_CALL line per tool call in adapter.log, with no token values

gbrain_mcp: with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL and HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN set, a second MCP server named gbrain is initialized beside world before ready; unset, nothing changes
gbrain_install: not implemented: HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL set to any value is HE-ADAPTER-006 and exit 2 before ready, with $HE_LOG_DIR/gbrain-install.json (status error)
internal_network: serves on network internal (tests/internal-network-harnesses.test.ts): one turn through the lease-mode proxy on the cell model with a world-MCP post_message landed; from inside the container the proxy port connects and 1.1.1.1:443 and chatgpt.com:443 fail
